sentences.zh: 禿髮武台憑城距守，熾磐攻之，一旬而克。

translations.literal: Tufa Wutai held the city and resisted; Chipan attacked and took it in ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Tufa Wutai held the city; Chipan took it in ten days.

sentences.zh: 遂入樂都，論功行賞各有差。

translations.literal: He then entered Ledu and rewarded merit according to achievement.
translations.idiomatic: He entered Ledu and rewarded merit by rank.

sentences.zh: 遣平遠犍虔率騎五千追傉檀，徙武台與其文武及百姓萬餘戶於枹罕。

translations.literal: He sent Pingyuan Jianqian with five thousand horsemen in pursuit of Rutan, moving Wutai with his civil and military officials and more than ten thousand households of common people to Fuhan.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Jianqian with five thousand horsemen after Rutan and moved Wutai with his officials and more than ten thousand households to Fuhan.

sentences.zh: 傉檀遂降，署為驃騎大將軍、左南公。

translations.literal: Rutan then surrendered and was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Zuonan.
translations.idiomatic: Rutan submitted and was made General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Zuonan.

sentences.zh: 隨傉檀文武，依才銓擢之。

translations.literal: Following Rutan's civil and military officials, he selected and promoted them according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted Rutan's officials according to talent.

sentences.zh: 熾磐既兼傉檀，兵強地廣，置百官，立其妻禿髮氏為王后。

translations.literal: Chipan, having absorbed Rutan, was strong in arms and broad in territory; he established the hundred offices and made his wife of the Tufa clan queen.
translations.idiomatic: Having absorbed Rutan, Chipan was strong in arms and broad in lands; he established offices and made his Tufa wife queen.

sentences.zh: 十一年，熾磐攻克沮渠蒙遜河湟太守沮渠漢平，以其左衛匹逵為河湟太守，因討降乙弗窟乾而還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Chipan stormed Juqu Mengxun's Hexi Administrator Juqu Hanping, made his Left Guard Pidi Hexi Administrator, and campaigning against the Yifu subdued Kugan and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he took Juqu Mengxun's Hexi administrator Juqu Hanping, made his Left Guard Pidi Hexi administrator, subdued the Yifu Kugan, and returned.

sentences.zh: 遣其將曇達、王松壽等討南羌彌姐康薄于赤水，降之。

translations.literal: He sent his generals Tanda and Wang Songshou to campaign against the Southern Qiang Minjie Kangbo at Chishui and received his submission.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Tanda and Wang Songshou against the Southern Qiang Minjie Kangbo at Chishui and received his submission.

sentences.zh: 熾磐攻漒川，師次遝中，沮渠蒙遜率眾攻石泉以救之。

translations.literal: Chipan attacked Qiangchuan; the army reached Diezhong; Juqu Mengxun led his host to attack Shiquan to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan attacked Qiangchuan; at Diezhong, Juqu Mengxun attacked Shiquan to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 熾磐聞而引還，遣曇達與其將出連虔率騎五千赴之。

translations.literal: Chipan, hearing of it, withdrew and sent Tanda with his general Chulian Qian and five thousand horsemen to go to its aid.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of it, Chipan withdrew and sent Tanda with Chulian Qian and five thousand horsemen to its aid.

sentences.zh: 蒙遜聞曇達至，引歸，遣使聘於熾磐，遂結和親。

translations.literal: Mengxun, hearing Tanda had arrived, withdrew and sent envoys seeking alliance with Chipan; they then formed a marriage bond.
translations.idiomatic: Mengxun withdrew on hearing Tanda had arrived and sent envoys to seek alliance; they formed a marriage bond.

sentences.zh: 又遣曇達、王松壽等率騎一萬伐姚艾於上邽。

translations.literal: He again sent Tanda and Wang Songshou with ten thousand horsemen to campaign against Yao Ai at Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent Tanda and Wang Songshou with ten thousand horsemen against Yao Ai at Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 曇達進據蒲水，艾距戰，大敗之，艾奔上邽。

translations.literal: Tanda advanced to hold Pu River; Ai opposed him in battle and was utterly defeated; Ai fled to Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: Tanda held Pu River; Ai gave battle and was routed; Ai fled to Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 曇達進屯大利，破黃石、大羌二戍，徙五千餘戶於枹罕。

translations.literal: Tanda advanced to garrison Dali, stormed the two garrisons of Huangshi and Daqiang, and moved more than five thousand households to Fuhan.
translations.idiomatic: Tanda garrisoned Dali, took Huangshi and Daqiang, and moved more than five thousand households to Fuhan.

sentences.zh: 令其安東木奕於率騎七千討吐谷渾樹洛幹於塞上，破其弟阿柴于堯扞川，俘獲五千餘口而還，洛幹奔保白蘭山而死。

translations.literal: He ordered his Pacifier of the East Muyuqiu to lead seven thousand horsemen to campaign against the Tuyuhun Shuluogan on the frontier, defeated his younger brother Achai at Yaoqian River, returned with more than five thousand captives, and Shuluogan fled to hold Bailan Mountain and died.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Muyuqiu with seven thousand horsemen against Tuyuhun Shuluogan on the frontier, defeated his brother Achai at Yaoqian River, returned with more than five thousand captives, and Shuluogan fled to Bailan Mountain and died.

sentences.zh: 熾磐聞而喜曰：「此虜矯矯，所謂有豕白蹢。

translations.literal: Chipan, hearing of it, rejoiced and said, "This barbarian was spirited—what they call a boar with white hooves.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan rejoiced and said: "That barbarian was spirited—what they call a boar with white hooves.

sentences.zh: 往歲曇達東征，姚艾敗走；

translations.literal: In former years Tanda campaigned east and Yao Ai fled in defeat;
translations.idiomatic: In former years Tanda campaigned east and Yao Ai fled;

sentences.zh: 今木奕於西討，黠虜遠逃。

translations.literal: now Muyuqiu campaigns west and the cunning barbarian flees far away.
translations.idiomatic: now Muyuqiu campaigns west and the cunning barbarian flees far away.

sentences.zh: 境宇稍清，奸凶方殄，股肱惟良，吾無患矣。

translations.literal: The realm is gradually cleared, traitors and villains are being extinguished, and my arms and legs are all worthy men—I have no worry."
translations.idiomatic: The realm grows clear, traitors are being cut down, and my lieutenants are worthy—I have no worry."

sentences.zh: 」於是以曇達為左丞相，其子元基為右丞相，麹景為尚書令，翟紹為左僕射。

translations.literal: He therefore made Tanda Left Chancellor, his son Yuanji Right Chancellor, Qu Jing Head of the Secretariat, and Zhai Shao Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He made Tanda left chancellor, his son Yuanji right chancellor, Qu Jing head of the secretariat, and Zhai Shao left vice director.

sentences.zh: 遣曇達、元基東討姚艾，降之。

translations.literal: He sent Tanda and Yuanji east to campaign against Yao Ai and received his submission.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Tanda and Yuanji east against Yao Ai and received his submission.

sentences.zh: 至是，乙弗鮮卑烏地延率戶二萬降於熾磐，署為建義將軍。

translations.literal: At this time the Yifu Xianbei Wudiyan led twenty thousand households to surrender to Chipan and was appointed General Who Establishes Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The Yifu Xianbei Wudiyan brought twenty thousand households to submit and was made General Who Establishes Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 地延尋死，弟他子立，以子軻蘭質于西平。

translations.literal: Wudiyan soon died; his younger brother Tazi succeeded and sent his son Kelan as hostage to Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: Wudiyan soon died; his brother Tazi succeeded and sent his son Kelan as hostage to Xiping.

sentences.zh: 他子從弟提孤等率戶五千以西遷，叛於熾磐。

translations.literal: Tazi's younger cousin Tigui and others led five thousand households to migrate west, rebelling against Chipan.
translations.idiomatic: Tazi's cousin Tigui and others led five thousand households west in rebellion against Chipan.

sentences.zh: 涼州刺史出連虔遣使喻之，提孤等歸降。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Liangzhou Chulian Qian sent envoys to persuade them; Tigui and the others returned and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Liangzhou Chulian Qian persuaded them; Tigui and the others submitted.

sentences.zh: 熾磐以提孤奸猾，終為邊患，稅其部中戎馬六萬匹。

translations.literal: Chipan, because Tigui was crafty and would in the end be a border worry, levied sixty thousand war-horses from his division.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan, judging Tigui crafty and a future border menace, levied sixty thousand war-horses from his division.

sentences.zh: 後二歲而提孤等扇動部落，西奔出塞。

translations.literal: Two years later Tigui and the others incited the tribes and fled west beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Tigui incited the tribes and fled west beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 他子率戶五千入居西平。

translations.literal: Tazi led five thousand households to settle in Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: Tazi led five thousand households to settle in Xiping.

sentences.zh: 先是，姚艾叛降蒙遜，蒙遜率眾迎之。

translations.literal: Before this, Yao Ai had rebelled and submitted to Mengxun; Mengxun led his host to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yao Ai had rebelled and submitted to Mengxun, who led his host to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 艾叔父俊言于眾曰：「秦王寬仁有雅度，自可安土事之，何為從涼主西遷？

translations.literal: Ai's uncle Jun said to the host, "Prince Chipan is generous and has refined measure; one can settle on one's lands and serve him—why follow the Lord of Liang west in migration?
translations.idiomatic: Ai's uncle Jun told the host: "Prince Chipan is generous and measured; settle and serve him—why follow the Lord of Liang west?

sentences.zh: 」眾咸以為然，相率逐艾，推俊為主，遣使請降。

translations.literal: The host all thought it so; together they drove Ai off and raised Jun as leader, sending envoys to request surrender.
translations.idiomatic: All agreed; they drove off Ai, raised Jun as leader, and asked to submit.

sentences.zh: 熾磐大悅，征俊為侍中、中書監、征南將軍，封隴西公，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: Chipan was greatly pleased, summoned Jun as Attendant-in-Ordinary, Director of the Secretariat, General Who Campaigns South, enfeoffed him as Duke of Longxi with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan was delighted, summoned Jun as attendant-in-ordinary, director of the secretariat, General Who Campaigns South, and Duke of Longxi with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 使征西孔子討吐谷渾覓地于弱水南，大破之。

translations.literal: He sent General Who Campaigns West Kongzi to campaign against the Tuyuhun Midi south of the Ruoshui and routed him utterly.
translations.idiomatic: He sent General Who Campaigns West Kongzi against Tuyuhun Midi south of the Ruoshui and crushed him.

sentences.zh: 覓地率眾六千降於熾磐，署為弱水護軍。

translations.literal: Midi led six thousand followers to surrender to Chipan and was appointed Protector of the Army of Ruoshui.
translations.idiomatic: Midi brought six thousand followers to submit and was made Protector of the Army of Ruoshui.

sentences.zh: 遣其左衛匹逵，建威梯君等討彭利和於漒川，大破之，利和單騎奔仇池，獲其妻子。

translations.literal: He sent his Left Guard Pidi, General Who Establishes Prestige Tijun, and others to campaign against Peng Lihe at Qiangchuan, routed him utterly; Lihe fled alone on horseback to Chouchi and they captured his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Pidi and Tijun against Peng Lihe at Qiangchuan, crushed him; Lihe fled alone to Chouchi and they took his wife and children.

sentences.zh: 徙羌豪三千戶於枹罕，漒川羌三萬餘戶皆安堵如故。

translations.literal: He moved three thousand Qiang chieftains' households to Fuhan, and the more than thirty thousand households of Qiangchuan all dwelt secure as before.
translations.idiomatic: He moved three thousand Qiang chieftains' households to Fuhan, and more than thirty thousand Qiangchuan households dwelt secure as before.

sentences.zh: ，立其第二子慕末為太子，領撫軍大將軍、都督中外諸軍事，大赦境內，改元曰建弘，其臣佐等多所封授。

translations.literal: He established his second son Mumo as heir apparent, General Who Pacifies the Army and Commander-in-Chief of Central and Outer Military Affairs, declared a great amnesty within the realm, changed the era name to Jianhong, and many of his ministers and assistants received fiefs and appointments.
translations.idiomatic: He made his second son Mumo heir apparent, General Who Pacifies the Army and commander of central and outer armies, declared a great amnesty, changed the era to Jianhong, and enfeoffed many ministers.

sentences.zh: 熾磐在位七年而宋氏受禪，以宋元嘉四年死。

translations.literal: Chipan reigned seven years when the Song house received the mandate; he died in the fourth year of Yuanjia of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan reigned seven years until the Song received the mandate; he died in Song Yuanjia year 4.

sentences.zh: 子慕末嗣偽位，在位四年，為赫連定所殺。

translations.literal: His son Mumo succeeded to the presumptuous throne, reigned four years, and was killed by Helian Ding.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mumo succeeded, reigned four years, and was killed by Helian Ding.

sentences.zh: 始國仁以孝武僭位，至慕末四世，凡四十有六載而滅。

translations.literal: From the time Guoren presumptuously took the throne as Xiaowu to Mumo, four generations in all, forty-six years passed and they were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: From Guoren's presumptuous reign as Xiaowu to Mumo, four generations and forty-six years passed until destruction.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：夫天地閉，大昆生；

translations.literal: The historiographer says: When Heaven and Earth are closed, the Great Kun is born;
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: When Heaven and Earth are closed, the Great Kun is born;

sentences.zh: 雲雷屯，群凶作。

translations.literal: when cloud and thunder are massed, the many villains arise.
translations.idiomatic: when cloud and thunder gather, villains arise.

sentences.zh: 自晉室遘孽，胡兵肆禍，封域無紀，干戈是務。

translations.literal: From the time the Jin house met with calamity, Hu armies wreaked disaster, borders had no rule, and weapons were the only business.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin house met calamity, Hu armies ravaged the land, borders lost all rule, and war was the only business.

sentences.zh: 國仁陰山遺噍，難以義服，伺我阽危，長其陵暴。

translations.literal: Guoren was a remnant morsel of the Yin Mountains, hard to subdue by righteousness; watching our peril, he grew in arrogance and violence.
translations.idiomatic: Guoren was a remnant of the Yin Mountains, not to be won by righteousness alone; watching our peril, he grew arrogant and violent.

sentences.zh: 向使偶欽明之運，遭雄略之主，已當褫魂沙漠，請命槁街，豈暇竊據近郊，經綸王業者也。

translations.literal: Had he chanced upon an age of bright worthies and a lord of heroic stratagem, he would already have lost his soul in the desert and begged for his life at Gaojie—how could he have seized the near suburbs and woven a royal enterprise?
translations.idiomatic: Had he met an age of bright worthies and a lord of heroic stratagem, he would have lost his soul in the desert and begged for life at Gaojie—how could he have seized the near suburbs and woven a royal enterprise?

sentences.zh: 乾歸智不及遠而以力詐自矜。

translations.literal: Gangui's wisdom did not reach far, yet he prided himself on force and deceit.
translations.idiomatic: Gangui's wisdom did not reach far, yet he prided himself on force and deceit.

sentences.zh: 陷呂延之師，奸謀潛斷；

translations.literal: He trapped Lü Yan's army and secretly cut off his stratagems;
translations.idiomatic: He trapped Lü Yan's army and cut off his stratagems by deceit;

sentences.zh: 俘視羆之眾，威策遐舉。

translations.literal: he captured Shipi's host and by prestige and stratagem raised campaigns in the distance.
translations.idiomatic: he captured Shipi's host and by prestige and stratagem campaigned far abroad.

sentences.zh: 便欲誓湃、隴之餘卒，窺崤、函之奧區，秣疲馬而宵征，翦勍敵而朝食。

translations.literal: He wished to swear the weary troops of the Tao and Long, spy on the hidden heartland of Xiao and Han, feed tired horses for night marches, and cut fierce foes for the morning meal.
translations.idiomatic: He meant to swear the weary troops of the Tao and Long, spy on the heartland of Xiao and Han, feed tired horses for night marches, and cut fierce foes for the morning meal.

sentences.zh: 既而控弦嗚鏑，厥志未逞，沮岸崩山，其功已喪。

translations.literal: Yet though he drew the bow and the arrow whistled, his will was not fulfilled; the bank collapsed and the mountain fell, and his achievement was already lost.
translations.idiomatic: Yet though he drew the bow and the arrow whistled, his will was not fulfilled; bank and mountain collapsed, and his achievement was lost.

sentences.zh: 履重氛於外難，幸以計全；

translations.literal: Treading heavy peril from external hardship, he was lucky to preserve himself by stratagem;
translations.idiomatic: Facing heavy peril from without, he preserved himself by stratagem;

sentences.zh: 貽巨釁于蕭牆，終成凶禍，宜哉！

translations.literal: he left a great fault within the palace screen and in the end met a violent end—fitting indeed!
translations.idiomatic: but he left a great fault within the palace screen and met a violent end—fitting indeed!

sentences.zh: 熾磐叱吒風雲，見機而動，牢籠俊傑，決勝多奇，故能命將掩澆河之酋，臨戎襲樂都之地，不盈數載，遂隆偽業。

translations.literal: Chipan thundered through wind and cloud, acted when he saw opportunity, gathered outstanding men, and won by many stratagems; therefore he could order generals to strike the chiefs of Jiao River, take the field himself to raid the land of Ledu, and in but a few years raise a presumptuous enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan thundered through wind and cloud, acted on opportunity, gathered outstanding men, and won by stratagem; he ordered generals against the chiefs of Jiao River, took the field at Ledu, and in a few years raised a presumptuous realm.

sentences.zh: 覽其遺跡，盜亦有道乎！

translations.literal: Surveying his traces, even a robber has his way!
translations.idiomatic: Surveying his traces—even a robber has his way!

sentences.zh: 馮跋

translations.literal: Feng Ba
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ba

sentences.zh: 馮跋，字文起，長樂信都人也，小字乞直伐，其先畢萬之後也。

translations.literal: Feng Ba, styled Wenqi, was a man of Xindu in Changle; his childhood name was Qizhifa; his ancestors were descendants of Bi Wan.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ba, styled Wenqi, was from Xindu in Changle; his childhood name was Qizhifa; his ancestors were descendants of Bi Wan.

sentences.zh: 萬之子孫有食采馮鄉者，因以氏焉。

translations.literal: Among Wan's descendants was one who received Feng as a fief and took it as surname.
translations.idiomatic: Among Bi Wan's descendants was one who held Feng as a fief and took it as his surname.

sentences.zh: 永嘉之亂，跋祖父和避地上黨。

translations.literal: In the disorders of Yongjia, Ba's grandfather He fled to settle in Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongjia disorders, Ba's grandfather He fled to Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 父安，雄武有器量，慕容永時為將軍。

translations.literal: His father An was fierce in martial bearing and had capacity; under Murong Yong he was a general.
translations.idiomatic: His father An was fierce and measured; under Murong Yong he served as a general.

sentences.zh: 永滅，跋東徙和龍，家于長穀。

translations.literal: When Yong was destroyed, Ba moved east to Helong and made his home at Changgu.
translations.idiomatic: When Yong fell, Ba moved east to Helong and settled at Changgu.

sentences.zh: 幼而懿重少言，寬仁有大度，飲酒一石不亂。

translations.literal: From youth he was refined and grave, spoke little, generous and of great measure, and could drink a dan of wine without disorder.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was refined and grave, spoke little, generous and measured, and could drink a dan of wine without losing himself.

sentences.zh: 三弟皆任俠，不修行業，惟跋恭慎，勤于家產，父母器之。

translations.literal: His three younger brothers were all chivalrous ruffians who did not cultivate proper conduct; only Ba was respectful and cautious, diligent in the family estate, and his parents valued him.
translations.idiomatic: His three younger brothers were chivalrous ruffians who neglected proper conduct; only Ba was respectful and diligent in the family estate, and his parents valued him.

sentences.zh: 所居上每有雲氣若樓閣，時咸異之。

translations.literal: Above the place where he dwelt there was often cloud vapor like towers and pavilions, and all regarded it as strange.
translations.idiomatic: Above his dwelling cloud vapor often formed like towers and pavilions, and all regarded it as strange.

sentences.zh: 嘗夜見天門開，神光赫然燭於庭內。

translations.literal: Once at night he saw the Gate of Heaven open, and divine light blazed brilliantly, illuminating the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Once at night he saw the Gate of Heaven open and divine light blaze across the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 及慕容寶僭號，署中衛將軍。

translations.literal: When Murong Bao presumptuously took the throne, he appointed Ba General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Murong Bao took the throne, he appointed Ba General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 初，跋弟素弗與從兄萬泥及諸少年游于水濱，有一金龍浮水而下，素弗謂萬泥曰：「頗有見否？

translations.literal: In the beginning, Ba's younger brother Sufu with his cousin Wan Ni and various youths were playing by the waterside when a golden dragon floated down the water; Sufu said to Wan Ni, "Did you see anything?"
translations.idiomatic: At first Ba's brother Sufu with his cousin Wan Ni and other youths were playing by the water when a golden dragon floated down; Sufu asked Wan Ni: "Did you see anything?"

sentences.zh: 」萬泥等皆曰：「無所見也。

translations.literal: Wan Ni and the others all said, "We saw nothing."
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni and the others said: "We saw nothing."

sentences.zh: 」乃取龍而示之，咸以為非常之瑞。

translations.literal: He then took out the dragon and showed it to them; all regarded it as an extraordinary omen.
translations.idiomatic: He took out the dragon and showed them; all regarded it as an extraordinary omen.

sentences.zh: 慕容熙聞而求焉，素弗秘之，熙怒。

translations.literal: Murong Xi, hearing of it, sought it; Sufu kept it secret, and Xi was angry.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Xi, hearing of it, demanded it; Sufu kept it secret and Xi grew angry.

sentences.zh: 及即偽位，密欲誅跋兄弟。

translations.literal: When he took the presumptuous throne, he secretly wished to execute the Ba brothers.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne he secretly wished to execute the Ba brothers.

sentences.zh: 其後跋又犯熙禁，懼禍，乃與其諸弟逃于山澤。

translations.literal: Later Ba again violated Xi's prohibitions; fearing disaster, he fled with his brothers to the mountains and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ba again violated Xi's prohibitions; fearing disaster, he fled with his brothers to the mountains and marshes.

sentences.zh: 每夜獨行，猛獸常為避路。

translations.literal: Each night he walked alone, and fierce beasts always made way for him.
translations.idiomatic: Each night he walked alone and fierce beasts always made way for him.

sentences.zh: 時賦役繁數，人不堪命，跋兄弟謀曰：「熙今昏虐，兼忌吾兄弟，既還首無路，不可坐受誅滅。

translations.literal: At that time levies and corvée were numerous and the people could not bear their lives; the Ba brothers plotted, saying, "Xi is now benighted and cruel and moreover envies us brothers; having no road back if we surrender our heads, we cannot sit and await execution.
translations.idiomatic: Levies were heavy and the people could not endure; the Ba brothers plotted: "Xi is benighted and cruel and envies us; we cannot sit and await execution.

sentences.zh: 當及時而起，立公侯之業。

translations.literal: We should rise in good time and establish the enterprise of lords and marquises.
translations.idiomatic: We should rise in time and establish a lordly enterprise.

sentences.zh: 事若不成，死其晚乎！

translations.literal: If the affair does not succeed, is it not better to die late!"
translations.idiomatic: If we fail, is it not better to die late!"

sentences.zh: 」遂與萬泥等二十二人結謀。

translations.literal: They then formed a plot with Wan Ni and twenty-two others.
translations.idiomatic: They formed a plot with Wan Ni and twenty-two others.

sentences.zh: 跋與二弟乘車，使婦人禦，潛入龍城，匿于北部司馬孫護之室。

translations.literal: Ba and his two younger brothers rode in a carriage, had women drive, secretly entered Longcheng, and hid in the house of the Northern Division Marshal Sun Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Ba and his two brothers rode in a carriage driven by women, secretly entered Longcheng, and hid in Sun Hu's house.

sentences.zh: 遂殺熙，立高雲為主。

translations.literal: They then killed Xi and raised Gao Yun as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: They killed Xi and raised Gao Yun as ruler.

sentences.zh: 雲署跋為使持節、侍中、都督中外諸軍事、征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、錄尚書事、武邑公。

translations.literal: Yun appointed Ba Bearer of the Staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Commander-in-Chief of Central and Outer Military Affairs, General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies, Recorder of the Secretariat, and Duke of Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Yun appointed Ba bearer of the staff, attendant-in-ordinary, commander of central and outer armies, General Who Campaigns North, commissioner equal to the three excellencies, recorder of the secretariat, and Duke of Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 跋宴群僚，忽有血流其左臂，跋惡之。

translations.literal: When Ba feasted his ministers, blood suddenly flowed on his left arm; Ba took it as ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: While feasting his ministers, blood flowed on Ba's left arm; he took it as ill omen.

sentences.zh: 從事中郎王垂因說符命之應，跋戒其勿言。

translations.literal: Attendant Zhonglang Wang Chui thereupon spoke of the response of the mandate of signs; Ba warned him not to speak.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Zhonglang Wang Chui spoke of the mandate of signs; Ba warned him not to speak.

sentences.zh: 雲為其幸臣離班、桃仁所殺，跋升洪光門以觀變。

translations.literal: Yun was killed by his favored ministers Li Ban and Taoren; Ba ascended Hongguang Gate to observe the disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Yun was killed by his favorites Li Ban and Taoren; Ba ascended Hongguang Gate to observe.

sentences.zh: 帳下督張泰、李桑謂跋曰：「此豎勢何所至！

translations.literal: The camp supervisors Zhang Tai and Li Sang said to Ba, "How far can this villain's power reach!
translations.idiomatic: Camp supervisors Zhang Tai and Li Sang told Ba: "How far can this villain's power reach!

sentences.zh: 請為公斬之。

translations.literal: Please let us behead him for you.
translations.idiomatic: Let us behead him for you.

sentences.zh: 」於是奮劍而下，桑斬班於西門，泰殺仁於庭中。

translations.literal: Thereupon they drew their swords and descended; Sang beheaded Ban at the western gate, Tai killed Ren in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: They drew swords; Sang beheaded Ban at the western gate and Tai killed Ren in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 眾推跋為主，跋曰：「范陽公素弗才略不恆，志於靖亂，掃清凶桀，皆公勳也。

translations.literal: The host raised Ba as ruler; Ba said, "Duke of Fanyang Sufu's talent and stratagem are not ordinary; his will is set on quelling disorder and sweeping away the fierce and wicked—all is your merit, sir."
translations.idiomatic: The host raised Ba as ruler; Ba said: "Duke of Fanyang Sufu's talent is extraordinary; his will is to quell disorder and sweep away the wicked—all is your merit."

sentences.zh: 」素弗辭曰：「臣聞父兄之有天下，傳之於子弟，未聞子弟籍父兄之業而先之。

translations.literal: Sufu declined, saying, "I have heard that when fathers and elder brothers possess the realm they pass it to sons and younger brothers; I have not heard that younger brothers seize the enterprise of fathers and elder brothers and go before them.
translations.idiomatic: Sufu declined: "Fathers and elder brothers pass the realm to sons and younger brothers; I have not heard that younger brothers seize their elders' enterprise and go before them.

sentences.zh: 今鴻基未建，危甚綴旒，天工無曠，業系大兄。

translations.literal: Now the great foundation is not yet established and peril hangs like a dangling tassel; Heaven's work admits no vacancy—the enterprise rests on the eldest brother.
translations.idiomatic: The foundation is not yet established and peril hangs like a dangling tassel; Heaven's work admits no vacancy—the enterprise rests on the eldest brother.

sentences.zh: 願上順皇天之命，下副元元之心。

translations.literal: We pray that above you follow Heaven's mandate and below answer the hearts of the masses."
translations.idiomatic: Above, follow Heaven's mandate; below, answer the hearts of the people."

sentences.zh: 」群臣固請，乃許之，於是乙太元二十年乃僭稱天王于昌黎，而不徙舊號，即國曰燕，赦其境內，建元曰太平。

translations.literal: The ministers pressed him firmly and he then consented; in the twentieth year of the Taian era of Eastern Jin he presumptuously styled himself Heavenly King at Changli without changing the old era name, named the state Yan, amnestied the realm, and established the era name Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers pressed him and he consented; in Eastern Jin Taian year 20 he styled himself Heavenly King at Changli, named the state Yan, declared an amnesty, and established the era Taiping.

sentences.zh: 分遣使者巡行郡國，觀察風俗。

translations.literal: He separately sent envoys to tour the commanderies and kingdoms and observe local customs.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to tour the commanderies and observe local customs.

sentences.zh: 追尊祖和為元皇帝，父安為宣皇帝，尊母張氏為太后，立妻孫氏為王后，子永為太子。

translations.literal: He posthumously honored his grandfather He as Emperor Yuan, his father An as Emperor Xuan, honored his mother Lady Zhang as empress dowager, established his wife Lady Sun as queen, and his son Yong as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his grandfather He as Emperor Yuan and his father An as Emperor Xuan, made his mother Lady Zhang empress dowager, his wife Lady Sun queen, and his son Yong heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 署弟素弗為侍中、車騎大將軍、錄尚書事，弘為侍中、征東大將軍、尚書右僕射、汲郡公，從兄萬泥為驃騎大將軍、幽平二州牧，務銀提為上大將軍、遼東太守，孫護為侍中、尚書令、陽平公，張興為衛將軍、尚書左僕射、永甯公，郭生為鎮東大將軍、領右衛將軍、陳留公，從兄子乳陳為征西大將軍、並青二州牧、上谷公，姚昭為鎮南大將軍、司隸校尉、上党公，馬弗勤為吏部尚書、廣宗公，王難為侍中、撫軍將軍、潁川公，自餘拜授，文武進位各有差。

translations.literal: He appointed his younger brother Sufu Attendant-in-Ordinary, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Recorder of the Secretariat; Hong Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Campaigns East, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Duke of Ji; his cousin Wan Ni General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of You and Ping provinces; Wuyin Ti Grand General and Administrator of Liaodong; Sun Hu Attendant-in-Ordinary, Head of the Secretariat, and Duke of Yangping; Zhang Xing Guard General, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Duke of Yongning; Guo Sheng General Who Pacifies the East, Commander of the Right Guard, and Duke of Chenliu; his cousin's son Ruchen General Who Campaigns West, Governor of Bing and Qing provinces, and Duke of Shanggu; Yao Zhao General Who Pacifies the South, Colonel Director of Retainers, and Duke of Shangdang; Ma Fuqin Minister of Personnel and Duke of Guangzong; Wang Nan Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Pacifies the Army, and Duke of Yingchuan; the rest received appointments and civil and military advancement according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Sufu attendant-in-ordinary, general of chariots and cavalry, and recorder of the secretariat; Hong attendant-in-ordinary, general who campaigns east, right vice director, and Duke of Ji; Wan Ni general of agile cavalry and governor of You and Ping; and the rest received ranks in due order.

sentences.zh: 尋而萬泥抗表請代，跋曰：「猥以不德，謬為群賢所推，思與兄弟同茲休戚。

translations.literal: Before long Wan Ni submitted a memorial requesting replacement; Ba said, "With slight virtue I have wrongly been pushed forward by the worthy; I wish to share fortune and misfortune with my brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni requested replacement; Ba said: "With slight virtue I have been pushed forward by the worthy; I wish to share fortune and misfortune with my brothers.

sentences.zh: 今方難未寧，維城任重，非明德懿親，孰克居也！

translations.literal: Now difficulties are not yet settled and the city-wall's weight is heavy—who but a bright and virtuous kinsman can occupy it!
translations.idiomatic: Difficulties are not settled and the city-wall's weight is heavy—who but a bright kinsman can bear it!

sentences.zh: 且折沖禦侮，為國籓屏，雖有他人，不如我弟兄，豈得如所陳也。

translations.literal: Moreover, to break the foe and repel insult is the state's screen; though there be others, none equals us brothers—how can I do as you propose?"
translations.idiomatic: To break the foe and repel insult is the state's screen; none equals us brothers—how can I do as you propose?"

sentences.zh: 」於是加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: He therefore added the protocol of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore added the protocol of the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: ，跋下書曰：「昔高祖為義帝舉哀，天下歸其仁。

translations.literal: Ba issued a proclamation, saying, "In former times the High Ancestor mourned for Emperor Yi of Righteousness, and the realm returned to his benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Ba issued a proclamation: "The High Ancestor mourned Emperor Yi of Righteousness and the realm returned to his benevolence.

sentences.zh: 吾與高雲義則君臣，恩逾兄弟。

translations.literal: Gao Yun and I in righteousness were ruler and minister, yet in kindness we exceeded brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yun and I were ruler and minister in righteousness, yet in kindness we exceeded brothers.

sentences.zh: 其以禮葬雲及其妻子，立雲廟於韭町，置園邑二十家，四時供薦。」

translations.literal: Let Yun and his wife and children be buried with rites, establish Yun's temple at Jiuding, set a park estate of twenty households, and offer sacrifices in the four seasons."
translations.idiomatic: Bury Yun and his wife and children with rites, establish Yun's temple at Jiuding, set a park estate of twenty households, and offer sacrifices in the four seasons."

sentences.zh: 初，跋之立也，萬泥、乳陳自以親而有大功，謂當入為公輔，跋以二籓任重，因而弗征，並有憾焉。

translations.literal: In the beginning, when Ba was established, Wan Ni and Ruchen, considering themselves kin and having great merit, thought they ought to enter as chief ministers; Ba, because the two frontier posts were weighty in responsibility, did not summon them, and both harbored resentment.
translations.idiomatic: When Ba was established, Wan Ni and Ruchen, as kin with great merit, expected chief minister posts; Ba left them on the frontier and both resented it.

sentences.zh: 乳陳性粗獷，勇氣過人，密遣告萬泥曰：「乳陳有至謀，顧與叔父圍之。

translations.literal: Ruchen was coarse and fierce, his courage surpassing others; he secretly sent word to Wan Ni, saying, "Ruchen has a supreme plan and wishes to surround them with you, uncle."
translations.idiomatic: Ruchen was coarse and fierce; he secretly told Wan Ni: "I have a supreme plan and wish to surround them with you, uncle."

sentences.zh: 」萬泥遂奔白狼，阻兵以叛。

translations.literal: Wan Ni then fled to Bailang and blocked the army in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni fled to Bailang and rebelled with his army.

sentences.zh: 跋遣馮弘與將軍張興將步騎二萬討之。

translations.literal: Ba sent Feng Hong with General Zhang Xing and twenty thousand foot and horse to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: Ba sent Feng Hong with Zhang Xing and twenty thousand foot and horse against them.

sentences.zh: 弘遣使喻之曰：「昔者兄弟乘風雲之運，撫翼而起。

translations.literal: Hong sent envoys to persuade them, saying, "In former times we brothers rode the fortune of wind and cloud and spread our wings to rise.
translations.idiomatic: Hong sent envoys: "We brothers rode the fortune of wind and cloud and rose together.

sentences.zh: 群公以天命所鍾，人望攸系，推逼主上光踐寶位。

translations.literal: The lords, because Heaven's mandate was concentrated and human expectation was attached, pushed forward the sovereign to ascend the precious throne.
translations.idiomatic: The lords, because Heaven's mandate was concentrated, pushed forward the sovereign to the throne.

sentences.zh: 裂土疏爵，當與兄弟共之，奈何欲尋干戈于蕭牆，棄友于而為閼伯！

translations.literal: Dividing land and enfeoffing ranks ought to be shared with brothers—how can you seek weapons within the palace screen, abandon brotherhood, and become Lord Yan!
translations.idiomatic: Land and rank ought to be shared with brothers—why seek weapons within the palace screen and abandon brotherhood!

sentences.zh: 過貴能改，善莫大焉。

translations.literal: He who corrects a fault is doing the greatest good.
translations.idiomatic: He who corrects a fault does the greatest good.

sentences.zh: 宜舍茲嫌，同獎王室。

translations.literal: You should set aside this resentment and together encourage the royal house."
translations.idiomatic: Set aside this resentment and together encourage the royal house."

sentences.zh: 」萬泥欲降，乳陳按劍怒曰：「大丈夫死生有命，決之於今，何謂降也。

translations.literal: Wan Ni wished to surrender; Ruchen grasped his sword angrily and said, "A great man's life and death have their mandate—decide it today; what is this talk of surrender!"
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni wished to surrender; Ruchen grasped his sword and said: "A great man's life and death have their mandate—decide today; what talk of surrender!"

sentences.zh: 」遂克期出戰。

translations.literal: They then fixed a date and went out to battle.
translations.idiomatic: They fixed a date and gave battle.

sentences.zh: 興謂弘曰：「賊明日出戰，今夜必來驚我營，宜命三軍以備不虞。

translations.literal: Xing said to Hong, "The foe will give battle tomorrow; tonight they will surely come to surprise our camp—you ought to order the three armies to guard against the unexpected."
translations.idiomatic: Xing told Hong: "The foe will fight tomorrow; tonight they will surprise our camp—order the three armies to guard against it."

sentences.zh: 」弘乃密嚴人課草十束，畜火伏兵以待之。

translations.literal: Hong then secretly had men prepare ten bundles of straw, stored fire, and set ambush troops to wait.
translations.idiomatic: Hong had men prepare ten bundles of straw, stored fire, and set ambush troops to wait.

sentences.zh: 是夜，乳陳果遣壯士千餘人來斫營。

translations.literal: That night Ruchen indeed sent more than a thousand stalwarts to strike the camp.
translations.idiomatic: That night Ruchen sent more than a thousand stalwarts to strike the camp.

sentences.zh: 眾火俱起，伏兵邀擊，俘斬無遺。

translations.literal: Fires rose on all sides; ambush troops intercepted and struck, capturing and beheading without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Fires rose on all sides; ambush troops struck and captured or beheaded all.

sentences.zh: 乳陳等懼而出降，弘皆斬之。

translations.literal: Ruchen and the others, in fear, came out to surrender; Hong beheaded them all.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Ruchen and the others surrendered; Hong beheaded them all.

sentences.zh: 署素弗為大司馬，改封遼西公，馮弘為驃騎大將軍，改封中山公。

translations.literal: He appointed Sufu Grand Marshal and changed his enfeoffment to Duke of Liaoxi; Feng Hong General of Agile Cavalry and changed his enfeoffment to Duke of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Sufu grand marshal and Duke of Liaoxi; Feng Hong general of agile cavalry and Duke of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 跋下書曰：「自頃多故，事難相尋，賦役系苦，百姓困窮。

translations.literal: Ba issued a proclamation, saying, "Recently many troubles, affairs hard to follow in succession, levies and corvée binding in bitterness—the common people are impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: Ba issued a proclamation: "Recently troubles have followed one another, levies have bound the people in bitterness, and the common people are impoverished.

sentences.zh: 宜加寬宥，務從簡易，前朝苛政，皆悉除之。

translations.literal: We ought to add leniency and pardon, striving for simplicity and ease; the harsh policies of the former court are all to be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: We ought to add leniency, strive for simplicity, and abolish the harsh policies of the former court."

sentences.zh: 守宰當垂仁惠，無得侵害百姓，蘭台都官明加澄察。

translations.literal: District defenders ought to extend benevolence and kindness and must not invade or harm the common people; the Directorates of the Orchid Terrace and the Capital should clarify and inspect this clearly."
translations.idiomatic: District defenders must extend benevolence and not harm the people; the directorates should inspect this clearly."

sentences.zh: 」初，慕容熙之敗也，工人李訓竊寶而逃，貲至巨萬，行貨于馬弗勤，弗勤以訓為方略令。

translations.literal: In the beginning, when Murong Xi was defeated, the craftsman Li Xun stole treasures and fled, his wealth reaching tens of millions; traveling he offered goods to Ma Fuqin, and Fuqin made Xun Strategist-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: When Murong Xi was defeated, the craftsman Li Xun stole treasures and fled with wealth reaching tens of millions; he offered goods to Ma Fuqin, who made Xun strategist-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 既而失志之士書之于闕下碑，馮素弗言之於跋，請免弗勤官，仍推罪之。

translations.literal: Before long men of lost ambition wrote on the stele below the palace gate; Feng Sufu spoke of it to Ba and requested that Fuqin be removed from office and guilt pushed onto him.
translations.idiomatic: Men of lost ambition wrote on the palace stele; Feng Sufu told Ba and asked that Fuqin be removed and guilt pushed onto him.

sentences.zh: 跋曰：「大臣無忠清之節，貨財公行於朝，雖由吾不明所致，弗勤宜肆諸市朝，以正刑憲。

translations.literal: Ba said, "Great ministers lack the integrity of loyalty and purity, and goods and wealth move openly in court—though this is caused by my lack of clarity, Fuqin ought to be displayed in the market and court to rectify penal law.
translations.idiomatic: Ba said: "Great ministers lack loyal integrity and wealth moves openly in court—though this is my lack of clarity, Fuqin ought to be displayed in the market to rectify the law.

sentences.zh: 但大業草創，彝倫未敘，弗勤拔自寒微，未有君子之志，其特原之。

translations.literal: But the great enterprise is newly founded and norms are not yet ordered; Fuqin was raised from cold and slight station and lacks the resolve of a gentleman—let him be specially pardoned."
translations.idiomatic: But the enterprise is newly founded and norms are not yet ordered; Fuqin was raised from humble station and lacks a gentleman's resolve—let him be pardoned."

sentences.zh: 李訓小人，污辱朝士，可東市考竟。

translations.literal: Li Xun is a petty man who defiled and insulted court officers—he may be examined to the end at the eastern market."
translations.idiomatic: Li Xun is a petty man who defiled court officers—examine him to the end at the eastern market."

sentences.zh: 」於是上下肅然，請賕路絕。

translations.literal: Thereupon above and below were reverent, and requests for bribes ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon above and below were reverent and requests for bribes ceased.

sentences.zh: 蝚蠕勇斛律遣使求跋女偽樂浪公主，獻馬三千匹，跋命其群下議之。

translations.literal: The Rouran chief Hulu led envoys seeking Ba's daughter, the presumptuous Princess of Lelang, and presented three thousand horses; Ba ordered his host to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran chief Hulu sought Ba's daughter, the presumptuous Princess of Lelang, and presented three thousand horses; Ba ordered deliberation.

sentences.zh: 素弗等議曰：「前代舊事，皆以宗女妻六夷，宜許以妃嬪之女，樂浪公主不宜下降非類。

translations.literal: Sufu and the others deliberated, saying, "The old affairs of former generations always took clan daughters to marry the six barbarians; we ought to consent with a daughter of consorts, but the Princess of Lelang ought not descend to marry an alien kind."
translations.idiomatic: Sufu and others said: "Former generations always married clan daughters to the six barbarians; we ought to consent with a consort's daughter, but the Princess of Lelang ought not descend to an alien kind."

sentences.zh: 」跋曰：「女生從夫，千里豈遠！

translations.literal: Ba said, "When a girl is born she follows her husband—are a thousand li far!
translations.idiomatic: Ba said: "A girl follows her husband—are a thousand li far!

sentences.zh: 朕方崇信殊俗，奈何欺之！

translations.literal: I am now about to honor and trust alien customs—how can I deceive them!"
translations.idiomatic: I honor alien customs—how can I deceive them!"

sentences.zh: 」乃許焉。

translations.literal: He therefore consented.
translations.idiomatic: He consented.

sentences.zh: 遣其遊擊秦都率騎二千，送其女婦於蝚蠕。

translations.literal: He sent his Mobile Commander Qin Du with two thousand horsemen to escort his daughter in marriage to the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Mobile Commander Qin Du with two thousand horsemen to escort his daughter to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 庫莫奚虞出庫真率三千餘落請交市，獻馬千匹，許之，處之于營丘。

translations.literal: The Kumo Xi chief Yuchu Kuizhen led more than three thousand households requesting trade markets, presented one thousand horses, and was permitted; they were settled at Yingqiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Kumo Xi Yuchu Kuizhen brought more than three thousand households requesting markets, presented one thousand horses, was permitted, and was settled at Yingqiu.

sentences.zh: 分遣使者巡行郡國，孤老久疾不能自存者，振穀帛有差，孝悌力田閨門和順者，皆褒顯之。

translations.literal: He separately sent envoys to tour the commanderies and kingdoms; the solitary old and long ill who could not support themselves were given grain and cloth in due measure; those filial, fraternal, diligent in fields, and harmonious within the household were all praised and displayed.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to tour the commanderies; the solitary old and long ill who could not support themselves received grain and cloth; the filial, fraternal, and harmonious were praised.

sentences.zh: 昌黎郝越、營丘張買成、周刁、溫建德、何纂以賢良皆擢敘之。

translations.literal: Hao Yue of Changli, Zhang Maicheng of Yingqiu, Zhou Diao, Wen Jiande, and He Zuan, for worthiness and goodness, were all selected and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Yue of Changli, Zhang Maicheng of Yingqiu, Zhou Diao, Wen Jiande, and He Zuan were promoted for worthiness.

sentences.zh: 遣其太常丞劉軒徙北部人五百戶于長谷，為祖父園邑。

translations.literal: He sent his Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Xuan to move five hundred households of northern people to Changgu as a park estate for his grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Xuan to move five hundred northern households to Changgu as his grandfather's park estate.

sentences.zh: 以其太子永領大單于，置四輔。

translations.literal: He made his heir apparent Yong Grand Shanyu and established four assistants.
translations.idiomatic: He made heir apparent Yong Grand Shanyu and established four assistants.

sentences.zh: 跋勵意農桑，勤心政事，乃下書省徭薄賦，墮農者戮之，力田者褒賞，命尚書紀達為之條制。

translations.literal: Ba encouraged sericulture and agriculture and was diligent in government affairs; he then issued a proclamation reducing corvée and lightening levies, beheading those who neglected agriculture, rewarding those diligent in fields, and ordered the Secretariat officer Ji Da to make regulations for it.
translations.idiomatic: Ba encouraged agriculture and was diligent in government; he reduced corvée and lightened levies, beheaded those who neglected fields, rewarded the diligent, and ordered Ji Da to make regulations.

sentences.zh: 每遣守宰，必親見東堂，問為政事之要，令極言無隱，以觀其志，於是朝野競勸焉。

translations.literal: Whenever he sent out district defenders, he always personally received them in the Eastern Hall, asked the essentials of conducting government affairs, ordered them to speak without concealment to observe their will, and thereby court and countryside competed in encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he sent district defenders, he received them in the Eastern Hall, asked the essentials of government, ordered them to speak without concealment, and court and countryside competed in effort.

sentences.zh: 先是，河間人褚匡言於跋曰：「陛下至德應期，龍飛東夏，舊邦宗族，傾首朝陽，以日為歲。

translations.literal: Before this, Chu Kuang of Hejian said to Ba, "Your Majesty's supreme virtue responds to the season and the dragon flies in the eastern Xia; the old homeland and clans all turn their heads to the morning sun, counting the days as years.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Chu Kuang of Hejian told Ba: "Your supreme virtue responds to the season; the old homeland and clans turn to the morning sun, counting days as years.

sentences.zh: 若聽臣往迎，致之不遠。

translations.literal: If you will hear me go to welcome them, bringing them is not far."
translations.idiomatic: If you will let me go welcome them, bringing them is not far."

sentences.zh: 」跋曰：「隔絕殊域，阻回數千，將何可致也？

translations.literal: Ba said, "Separated in a different realm, blocked and turned back by several thousands of li—how can they be brought?"
translations.idiomatic: Ba said: "Separated by a different realm and thousands of li—how can they be brought?"

sentences.zh: 」匡曰：「章武郡臨海，船路甚通，出於遼西臨渝，不為難也。

translations.literal: Kuang said, "Zhangwu commandery faces the sea; the shipping route is very open, going out from Linyu in Liaoxi—it is not difficult."
translations.idiomatic: Kuang said: "Zhangwu faces the sea; the route is open from Linyu in Liaoxi—it is not difficult."

sentences.zh: 」跋許之，署匡遊擊將軍、中書侍郎，厚加資遣。

translations.literal: Ba consented and appointed Kuang Mobile General and Attendant Secretariat Gentleman, generously providing funds for his dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Ba consented and appointed Kuang mobile general and attendant secretariat gentleman, generously funding his dispatch.

sentences.zh: 匡尋與跋從兄買、從弟睹自長樂率五千餘戶來奔，署買為衛尉，封城陽伯，睹為太常、高城伯。

translations.literal: Before long Kuang with Ba's cousin Mai and younger cousin Du from Changle led more than five thousand households to come in flight; he appointed Mai Commandant of the Guards and enfeoffed him Marquis of Chengyang, Du Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Marquis of Gaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Kuang with Ba's cousin Mai and younger cousin Du from Changle brought more than five thousand households; he made Mai commandant of the guards and Marquis of Chengyang, Du grand master of splendid happiness and Marquis of Gaocheng.

sentences.zh: 契丹庫莫奚降，署其大人為歸善王。

translations.literal: The Khitan and Kumo Xi submitted; he appointed their great chiefs Kings Who Return to Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan and Kumo Xi submitted; he made their great chiefs Kings Who Return to Goodness.

sentences.zh: 跋又下書曰：「今疆宇無虞，百姓甯業，而田畝荒穢，有司不隨時督察，欲今家給人足，不亦難乎！

translations.literal: Ba again issued a proclamation, saying, "Now the borders are without worry and the common people are secure in their occupations, yet fields lie waste and uncultivated—the responsible offices do not supervise in season; if we wish that every household be provided for and every man sufficient, is it not hard!"
translations.idiomatic: Ba again issued a proclamation: "The borders are without worry and the people secure, yet fields lie waste—the offices do not supervise in season; if we wish every household provided for, is it not hard!"

sentences.zh: 桑柘之益，有生之本。

translations.literal: The benefit of mulberry and paper-mulberry is the root of livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry and paper-mulberry are the root of livelihood.

sentences.zh: 此土少桑，人未見其利，可令百姓人殖桑一百根，柘二十根。

translations.literal: This land has little mulberry; the people have not seen its benefit—we may order every common person to plant one hundred mulberry roots and twenty paper-mulberry roots."
translations.idiomatic: This land has little mulberry; the people have not seen its benefit—order every household to plant one hundred mulberry roots and twenty paper-mulberry roots."

sentences.zh: 」又下書曰：「聖人制禮，送終有度。

translations.literal: He again issued a proclamation, saying, "The sages established rites; sending off the end has its measure.
translations.idiomatic: He again issued a proclamation: "The sages established rites; sending off the dead has its measure.

sentences.zh: 重其衣衾，厚其棺槨，將何用乎？

translations.literal: Heavy their shrouds, thick their inner and outer coffins—what use is it?
translations.idiomatic: Heavy shrouds, thick coffins—what use are they?

sentences.zh: 人之亡也，精魂上歸於天，骨肉下歸於地，朝終夕壞，無寒暖之期，衣以錦繡，服以羅紈，寧有知哉！

translations.literal: When a man dies, his refined spirit returns above to Heaven, his flesh and bones return below to earth; by morning's end and evening's ruin there is no period of cold or warmth—clothing them in brocade and silk, dressing them in gauze and silk—would they have awareness!
translations.idiomatic: When a man dies, spirit rises to Heaven and flesh returns to earth; by morning's end and evening's ruin there is no cold or warmth—would brocade and silk give awareness!

sentences.zh: 厚於送終，貴而改葬，皆無益亡者，有損於生。

translations.literal: Being heavy in sending off the end, valuing and changing burial—all is without benefit to the dead and harms the living.
translations.idiomatic: Being heavy in sending off the dead and valuing reburial benefits neither the dead nor the living.

sentences.zh: 是以祖考因舊立廟，皆不改營陵寢。

translations.literal: Therefore ancestors established temples on the old model and all did not alter or move the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore ancestors established temples on the old model and did not alter the tombs.

sentences.zh: 申下境內，自今皆令奉之。」

translations.literal: We order all within the borders from now on to observe this."
translations.idiomatic: We order all within the borders from now on to observe this."

sentences.zh: 魏使耿貳至其國，跋遣其黃門郎常陋迎之於道。

translations.literal: The Wei envoy Geng Er came to his state; Ba sent his Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Chang Lou to welcome him on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei envoy Geng Er came; Ba sent Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Chang Lou to welcome him on the road.

sentences.zh: 跋為不稱臣，怒而不見。

translations.literal: Because Ba did not style himself a vassal, Er was angry and would not receive him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ba would not style himself a vassal, Er was angry and refused to receive him.

sentences.zh: 及至，跋又遣陋勞之。

translations.literal: When Er arrived, Ba again sent Lou to comfort him with labor.
translations.idiomatic: When Er arrived, Ba again sent Lou to offer him comfort.

sentences.zh: 貳忿而不謝。

translations.literal: Er was resentful and did not thank him.
translations.idiomatic: Er was resentful and did not thank him.

sentences.zh: 跋散騎常侍申秀言於跋曰：「陛下接貳以禮，而敢驕蹇若斯，不可容也。

translations.literal: Ba's Attendant-in-Ordinary Shen Xiu said to Ba, "Your Majesty received Er with rites, yet he dares be so arrogant and obstinate—he cannot be tolerated."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant-in-Ordinary Shen Xiu told Ba: "Your Majesty received Er with rites, yet he dares be so arrogant—he cannot be tolerated."

sentences.zh: 」中給事馮懿以傾佞有幸，又盛稱貳之陵慠以激跋。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Feng Yi, by fawning flattery winning favor, also greatly praised Er's insolence to provoke Ba.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Feng Yi, favored for fawning flattery, also praised Er's insolence to provoke Ba.

sentences.zh: 跋曰：「亦各其志也。

translations.literal: Ba said, "Each has his own will.
translations.idiomatic: Ba said: "Each has his own will.

sentences.zh: 匹夫尚不可屈，況一方之主乎！

translations.literal: Even a common man ought not be bent—how much more the lord of a region!"
translations.idiomatic: Even a common man ought not be bent—how much more the lord of a region!"

sentences.zh: 」請幽而降之，跋乃留貳不遣。

translations.literal: He requested that Er be imprisoned and made to submit; Ba then detained Er and would not send him away.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that Er be imprisoned until he submitted; Ba detained Er and would not send him away.

sentences.zh: 是時井竭三日而復。

translations.literal: At that time the wells dried up for three days and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the wells dried up for three days and then returned.

sentences.zh: 其尚書令孫護裏有犬與豕交，護見而惡之，召太史令閔尚筮之。

translations.literal: His Head of the Secretariat Sun Hu's lane had a dog mating with a pig; Hu, seeing it, took it as ill omen and summoned Grand Astrologer Min Shang to divine it.
translations.idiomatic: Head of the Secretariat Sun Hu's lane had a dog mating with a pig; Hu took it as ill omen and summoned Grand Astrologer Min Shang to divine it.

sentences.zh: 尚曰：「犬豕異類而交，違性失本，其于《洪範》為犬禍，將勃亂失眾，以至敗亡。

translations.literal: Shang said, "Dog and pig are different kinds yet mate—against nature and losing the root; in the Hong Fan this is canine calamity; there will be sudden disorder, loss of the host, and ruin unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Shang said: "Dog and pig are different kinds yet mate—against nature; in the Hong Fan this is canine calamity; there will be sudden disorder, loss of the host, and ruin.

sentences.zh: 明公位極塚宰，遐邇具瞻，諸弟並封列侯，貴傾王室，妖見裏庭，不為他也。

translations.literal: Your Excellency's position reaches chief of the lineage; near and far all look to you; your younger brothers are all enfeoffed as marquises, your honor overturning the royal house—the omen appears in your courtyard; it is not for another."
translations.idiomatic: Your position reaches chief of the lineage; near and far look to you; your brothers are enfeoffed as marquises, your honor overturning the royal house—the omen is in your courtyard, not another's."

sentences.zh: 願公戒滿盈之失，修尚恭儉，則妖怪可消，永享元吉。

translations.literal: I pray Your Excellency guard against the fault of fullness, cultivate respect and frugality, and then the strange omen may be dispelled and you may forever enjoy supreme good fortune."
translations.idiomatic: Guard against the fault of fullness, cultivate respect and frugality, and the omen may be dispelled and you may enjoy supreme fortune."

sentences.zh: 」護默然不悅。

translations.literal: Hu was silent and displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Hu was silent and displeased.

sentences.zh: 昌黎尹孫伯仁、護弟叱支、叱支弟乙拔等俱有才力，以驍勇聞。

translations.literal: Changli Magistrate Sun Boren, Hu's younger brother Chizhi, and Chizhi's younger brother Yiba all had talent and strength and were known for fierce bravery.
translations.idiomatic: Changli Magistrate Sun Boren, Hu's brother Chizhi, and Chizhi's brother Yiba all had talent and were known for fierce bravery.

sentences.zh: 跋之立也，並冀開府，而跋未之許，由是有怨言。

translations.literal: When Ba was established, they all hoped to open a government office, but Ba did not consent, and therefore they had resentful words.
translations.idiomatic: When Ba was established they all hoped for a government office, but Ba did not consent, and they resented it.

sentences.zh: 每于朝饗之際，常拔劍擊柱曰：「興建大業，有功力焉，而滯於散將，豈是漢祖河山之義乎！

translations.literal: At every court feast they would draw swords and strike the pillar, saying, "In founding the great enterprise we had merit in labor, yet we stagnate as scattered generals—is this the righteousness of the Han Founder's rivers and mountains!"
translations.idiomatic: At every court feast they drew swords and struck the pillar: "We had merit in founding the great enterprise, yet we stagnate as scattered generals—is this the Han Founder's righteousness!"

sentences.zh: 」跋怒，誅之。

translations.literal: Ba was angry and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Ba was angry and executed them.

sentences.zh: 進護左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司、錄尚書事以慰之。

translations.literal: He advanced Hu to Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies, and Recorder of the Secretariat to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced Hu to left grand master of splendid happiness, commissioner equal to the three excellencies, and recorder of the secretariat to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 護自三弟誅後，常怏怏有不悅之色，跋怒，酖之。

translations.literal: After Hu's three younger brothers were executed, he was often sullen with an unhappy countenance; Ba was angry and poisoned him.
translations.idiomatic: After Hu's three brothers were executed, he was often sullen; Ba was angry and poisoned him.

sentences.zh: 尋而遼東太守務銀提自以功在孫護、張興之右，而出為邊郡，抗表有恨言，密謀外叛。

translations.literal: Before long the Administrator of Liaodong Wuyin Ti, considering his merit above Sun Hu and Zhang Xing yet sent out to a frontier commandery, submitted a memorial with resentful words and secretly plotted external rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Liaodong Administrator Wuyin Ti, considering his merit above Sun Hu and Zhang Xing yet sent to a frontier commandery, submitted a resentful memorial and secretly plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 跋怒，殺之。

translations.literal: Ba was angry and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ba was angry and killed him.

sentences.zh: 跋下書曰：「武以平亂，文以經務，甯國濟俗，實所憑焉。

translations.literal: Ba issued a proclamation, saying, "Martial affairs pacify disorder, civil affairs order administration—pacifying the state and benefiting custom truly depend on these."
translations.idiomatic: Ba issued a proclamation: "Martial affairs pacify disorder, civil affairs order administration—pacifying the state truly depends on these."

sentences.zh: 自頃喪難，禮崩樂壞，閭閻絕諷誦之音，後行無庠序之教，子衿之歎復興於今，豈所以穆章風化，崇闡斯文！

translations.literal: Recently, amid bereavement and calamity, rites collapsed and music was ruined; lanes and wards lacked the sound of recitation, and the younger generation had no school education—the sigh of the blue collar rises again today; how can this harmonize and rectify custom and gloriously extend this culture!"
translations.idiomatic: Recently rites collapsed and music was ruined; lanes lacked recitation and the young had no school education—how can this rectify custom and extend culture!"

sentences.zh: 可營建太學，以長樂劉軒、營丘張熾、成周翟崇為博士郎中，簡二千石已下子弟年十五已上教之。」

translations.literal: The Imperial University may be built, with Liu Xuan of Changle, Zhang Chi of Yingqiu, and Zhai Chong of Chengzou as erudite gentlemen of the Secretariat, selecting sons of officials of two thousand shi and below aged fifteen and above to teach them."
translations.idiomatic: Build the Imperial University, with Liu Xuan, Zhang Chi, and Zhai Chong as erudite gentlemen, teaching sons of officials of two thousand shi and below aged fifteen and above."

sentences.zh: 跋弟丕，先是因亂投於高句麗，跋迎致之，至龍城，以為左僕射、常山公。

translations.literal: Ba's younger brother Pi had earlier, amid disorder, fled to Goguryeo; Ba welcomed and brought him; when he reached Longcheng he made him Left Vice Director and Duke of Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: Ba's brother Pi had fled to Goguryeo amid disorder; Ba welcomed him to Longcheng and made him left vice director and Duke of Changshan.

sentences.zh: 蝚蠕斛律為其弟大但所逐，盡室奔跋，乃館之於遼東郡，待之以客禮。

translations.literal: The Rouran Hulu was driven out by his younger brother Datan and fled with his whole household to Ba; Ba lodged them in Liaodong commandery and treated them with guest rites.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran Hulu was driven out by his brother Datan and fled with his household to Ba; Ba lodged them in Liaodong and treated them as guests.

sentences.zh: 跋納其女為昭儀。

translations.literal: Ba took his daughter as Lady of Handsome Fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Ba took his daughter as a consort.

sentences.zh: 時三月不雨，至於夏五月。

translations.literal: At that time for three months there was no rain, until the fifth month of summer.
translations.idiomatic: For three months there was no rain, until the fifth month of summer.

sentences.zh: 斛律上書請還塞北，跋曰：「棄國萬里，又無內應。

translations.literal: Hulu submitted a memorial requesting return north of the passes; Ba said, "Abandoning your state for ten thousand li, moreover without internal support—
translations.idiomatic: Hulu asked to return north of the passes; Ba said: "Abandoning your state for ten thousand li without internal support—

sentences.zh: 若以強兵相送，糧運難繼；

translations.literal: if we send a strong army to escort you, grain transport is hard to continue;
translations.idiomatic: if we send a strong army, grain transport is hard to continue;

sentences.zh: 少也，勢不能固。

translations.literal: if few, the position cannot be held firm."
translations.idiomatic: if few, the position cannot be held."

sentences.zh: 且千里襲國，古人為難，況數千里乎！

translations.literal: Moreover, to strike a state a thousand li away the ancients considered hard—how much more several thousand li!"
translations.idiomatic: Striking a state a thousand li away the ancients considered hard—how much more several thousand!"

sentences.zh: 」斛律固請曰：「不煩大眾，願給騎三百足矣。

translations.literal: Hulu pressed his request firmly, saying, "It need not trouble the great host—I pray only three hundred horsemen will suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Hulu pressed his request: "It need not trouble the great host—three hundred horsemen will suffice.

sentences.zh: 得達敕勒國，人必欣而來迎。

translations.literal: Reaching the Tiele state, the people will surely rejoice and come to welcome me."
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the Tiele state, the people will rejoice and come to welcome me."

sentences.zh: 」乃許之，遣單于前輔萬陵率騎三百送之。

translations.literal: He was then permitted; he sent the Shanyu's Forward Assistant Wan Ling with three hundred horsemen to escort him.
translations.idiomatic: He consented and sent the Shanyu's Forward Assistant Wan Ling with three hundred horsemen to escort him.

sentences.zh: 陵憚遠役，至黑山，殺斛律而還。

translations.literal: Ling feared the distant service; at Black Mountain he killed Hulu and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Ling feared the distant service; at Black Mountain he killed Hulu and returned.

sentences.zh: 晉青州刺史申永遣使浮海來聘，跋乃使其中書郎李扶報之。

translations.literal: The Jin Inspector of Qingzhou Shen Yong sent envoys by sea to pay a court visit; Ba then sent his Secretariat Gentleman Li Fu to respond.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Inspector of Qingzhou Shen Yong sent envoys by sea; Ba sent Secretariat Gentleman Li Fu to respond.

sentences.zh: 蝚蠕大但遣使獻馬三千匹，羊萬口。

translations.literal: The Rouran Datan sent envoys presenting three thousand horses and ten thousand sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran Datan sent envoys with three thousand horses and ten thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 有赤氣四塞，太史令張穆言於跋曰：「兵氣也。

translations.literal: Red vapor filled the four quarters; Grand Astrologer Zhang Mu said to Ba, "It is the aura of armies.
translations.idiomatic: Red vapor filled the four quarters; Grand Astrologer Zhang Mu told Ba: "It is the aura of armies.

sentences.zh: 今大魏威制六合，而聘使斷絕。

translations.literal: Now Great Wei's prestige controls the six directions, yet envoys on court visits have ceased."
translations.idiomatic: Great Wei's prestige controls the six directions, yet court envoys have ceased."

sentences.zh: 自古未有鄰接境，不通和好。

translations.literal: From antiquity there has never been neighboring borders without communication of harmony and friendship.
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity neighboring borders have never lacked communication of friendship.

sentences.zh: 違義怒鄰，取亡之道。

translations.literal: To violate righteousness and anger neighbors is the way to invite destruction.
translations.idiomatic: To violate righteousness and anger neighbors is the way to destruction.

sentences.zh: 宜還前使，修和結盟。

translations.literal: You ought to return the former envoy and repair harmony and alliance."
translations.idiomatic: Return the former envoy and repair harmony and alliance."

sentences.zh: 」跋曰：「吾當思之。

translations.literal: Ba said, "I shall consider it."
translations.idiomatic: Ba said: "I shall consider it."

sentences.zh: 」尋而魏軍大至，遣單于右輔古泥率騎候之。

translations.literal: Before long the Wei army arrived in great strength; he sent the Shanyu's Right Assistant Gunai with horsemen to observe them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Wei army arrived in great strength; he sent the Shanyu's Right Assistant Gunai with horsemen to observe them.

sentences.zh: 去城十五里，遇軍奔還。

translations.literal: Fifteen li from the city they met the army and fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen li from the city they met the army and fled back.

sentences.zh: 又遣其將姚昭、皇甫軌等距戰，軌中流矢死。

translations.literal: He again sent his generals Yao Zhao, Huangfu Gui, and others to oppose them in battle; Gui was struck by a flowing arrow and died.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yao Zhao, Huangfu Gui, and others to oppose them; Gui was struck by an arrow and died.

sentences.zh: 魏以有備，引還。

translations.literal: Wei, because there was preparation, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, finding preparation, withdrew.

sentences.zh: 跋境地震山崩，洪光門鸛雀折。

translations.literal: Within Ba's borders the earth quaked and mountains collapsed; the magpie at Hongguang Gate broke its wing.
translations.idiomatic: Within Ba's borders the earth quaked and mountains collapsed; the magpie at Hongguang Gate broke its wing.

sentences.zh: 又地震，右寢壞。

translations.literal: Again the earth quaked and the right sleeping quarters collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Again the earth quaked and the right sleeping quarters collapsed.

sentences.zh: 跋問閔尚曰：「比年屢有地動之變，卿可明言其故。

translations.literal: Ba asked Min Shang, saying, "In recent years there have repeatedly been changes of earthquake—can you clearly state the reason?"
translations.idiomatic: Ba asked Min Shang: "In recent years there have repeatedly been earthquakes—can you state the reason?"

sentences.zh: 」尚曰：「地，陰也，主百姓。

translations.literal: Shang said, "Earth is yin and governs the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Shang said: "Earth is yin and governs the common people.

sentences.zh: 震有左右，此震皆向右，臣懼百姓將西移。

translations.literal: Earthquakes have left and right; these earthquakes all moved to the right—I fear the common people will shift west."
translations.idiomatic: Earthquakes have left and right; these all moved to the right—I fear the people will shift west."

sentences.zh: 」跋曰：「吾亦甚慮之。

translations.literal: Ba said, "I too am greatly concerned."
translations.idiomatic: Ba said: "I too am greatly concerned."

sentences.zh: 」分遣使者巡行郡國，問所疾苦，孤老不能自存者，賜以穀帛有差。

translations.literal: He separately sent envoys to tour the commanderies and kingdoms, asking what suffering there was; the solitary old who could not support themselves were given grain and cloth in due measure.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to tour the commanderies, asking what suffering there was; the solitary old who could not support themselves received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 跋立十一年，至是，也，此後事入于宋。

translations.literal: Ba had reigned eleven years; at this time—thereafter affairs entered into Song.
translations.idiomatic: Ba had reigned eleven years; at this point—thereafter affairs enter into the Song.

sentences.zh: 至死。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 弟弘殺跋子翼自立，後為魏所伐，東奔高句麗。

translations.literal: His younger brother Hong killed Ba's son Yi and established himself; later he was campaigned against by Wei, fled east to Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Hong killed Ba's son Yi and established himself; later Wei campaigned against him and he fled east to Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 居二年，高句麗殺之。

translations.literal: After two years Goguryeo killed him.
translations.idiomatic: After two years Goguryeo killed him.

sentences.zh: 始，跋以孝武僭號，至弘二世，凡二十有八載。

translations.literal: From the time Ba presumptuously took the throne as Xiaowu to Hong, two generations in all, twenty-eight years passed.
translations.idiomatic: From Ba's presumptuous reign as Xiaowu to Hong, two generations and twenty-eight years passed.

translations.literal: Section divider in the source text.

sentences.zh: 弟 素弗

translations.literal: Younger brother Sufu
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Sufu

sentences.zh: =馮素弗，跋之長弟也。

translations.literal: Feng Sufu was Ba's eldest younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Sufu was Ba's eldest younger brother.

sentences.zh: 慷慨有大志，姿貌魁偉，雄傑不群，任俠放蕩，不修小節，故時人未之奇，惟王齊異焉，曰：「撥亂才也。

translations.literal: Generous and bold with great resolve, of imposing stature, heroic and standing apart from the crowd, chivalrous and unrestrained, not cultivating small proprieties—therefore men of the time did not regard him as extraordinary; only Wang Qi regarded him differently, saying, "Talent for putting down disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Generous and bold with great resolve, imposing in stature, heroic and apart from the crowd, chivalrous and unrestrained, not cultivating small proprieties—men of the time did not regard him as extraordinary; only Wang Qi said: "Talent for putting down disorder."

sentences.zh: 」惟交結時豪為務，不以產業經懷。

translations.literal: He only made winning the bold heroes of the time his task and did not take estate and livelihood to heart.
translations.idiomatic: He only sought the bold heroes of the time and did not take estate to heart.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，自詣慕容熙尚書左丞韓業請婚，業怒而距之。

translations.literal: At weak cap he himself went to Murong Xi's Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Han Ye to request marriage; Ye was angry and refused him.
translations.idiomatic: At weak cap he went to Murong Xi's Left Vice Director Han Ye to request marriage; Ye angrily refused.

sentences.zh: 復求尚書郎高邵女，邵亦弗許。

translations.literal: He again sought the daughter of Secretariat Gentleman Gao Shao; Shao also would not consent.
translations.idiomatic: He again sought Secretariat Gentleman Gao Shao's daughter; Shao also refused.

sentences.zh: 南宮令成藻，豪俊有高名，素弗造焉，藻命門者勿納。

translations.literal: Nangong Magistrate Cheng Zao, a bold hero of high name—Sufu went to visit him; Zao ordered the gatekeeper not to admit him.
translations.idiomatic: Nangong Magistrate Cheng Zao, a bold hero of high name—Sufu visited him; Zao ordered the gatekeeper not to admit him.

sentences.zh: 素弗逕入，與藻對坐，旁若無人。

translations.literal: Sufu went straight in and sat facing Zao as if no one else were present.
translations.idiomatic: Sufu went straight in and sat facing Zao as if no one else were present.

sentences.zh: 談飲連日。

translations.literal: They talked and drank for successive days.
translations.idiomatic: They talked and drank for successive days.

sentences.zh: 藻始奇之，曰：「吾遠求騏驥，不知近在東鄰，何識子之晚也！

translations.literal: Zao then regarded him as extraordinary and said, "I sought a swift horse far away, not knowing it was near in the eastern neighbor—how late I knew you!"
translations.idiomatic: Zao then regarded him as extraordinary and said: "I sought a swift horse far away, not knowing it was near in the eastern neighbor—how late I knew you!"

sentences.zh: 」當世俠士莫不歸之。

translations.literal: The chivalrous warriors of the age all submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: The chivalrous warriors of the age all submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 及熙僭號，為侍御郎、小帳下督。

translations.literal: When Xi presumptuously took the throne, Sufu was Attendant of the Imperial Guard and Junior Commander of the Small Tent.
translations.idiomatic: When Xi took the throne, Sufu was attendant of the imperial guard and junior commander of the small tent.

sentences.zh: 跋之偽業，素弗所建也。

translations.literal: Ba's presumptuous enterprise was what Sufu established.
translations.idiomatic: Ba's presumptuous enterprise was what Sufu established.

sentences.zh: 及為宰輔，謙虛恭慎，非禮不動，雖廝養之賤，皆與之抗禮。

translations.literal: When he became chief minister, he was modest, respectful, and cautious; what was not rite he would not do; even menial servants of the lowest rank he treated with opposing rites.
translations.idiomatic: As chief minister he was modest, respectful, and cautious; what was not rite he would not do; even the lowest servants he treated with opposing rites.

sentences.zh: 車服屋宇，務於儉約，修己率下，百僚憚之。

translations.literal: Carriages, robes, and dwellings he strove to keep frugal; cultivating himself and leading those below, the hundred officials feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Carriages, robes, and dwellings he kept frugal; cultivating himself and leading those below, the hundred officials feared him.

sentences.zh: 初為京尹。

translations.literal: At first he was Metropolitan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was metropolitan governor.

sentences.zh: 及鎮營丘，百姓歌之。

translations.literal: When he garrisoned Yingqiu, the common people sang of him.
translations.idiomatic: When he garrisoned Yingqiu, the common people sang of him.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂韓業曰：「君前既不顧，今將自取，何如？

translations.literal: He once said to Han Ye, "You earlier would not look to me; now I shall take for myself—what of it?"
translations.idiomatic: He once told Han Ye: "You earlier would not look to me; now I shall take for myself—what of it?"

sentences.zh: 」業拜而陳謝。

translations.literal: Ye bowed and apologized.
translations.idiomatic: Ye bowed and apologized.

sentences.zh: 素弗曰：「既往之事，豈復與君計之！

translations.literal: Sufu said, "Past affairs—shall I reckon them with you again!"
translations.idiomatic: Sufu said: "Past affairs—shall I reckon them with you again!"

sentences.zh: 」然待業彌厚。

translations.literal: Yet he treated Ye all the more generously.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he treated Ye all the more generously.

sentences.zh: 好存亡繼絕，申拔舊門，問侍中陽哲曰：「秦、趙勳臣子弟今何在乎？

translations.literal: He loved preserving what was dying and continuing what was cut off, promoting old families; he asked Attendant-in-Ordinary Yang Zhe, saying, "Where are the sons and younger brothers of Qin and Zhao merit ministers now?"
translations.idiomatic: He loved preserving what was dying and continuing what was cut off; he asked Attendant-in-Ordinary Yang Zhe: "Where are the sons of Qin and Zhao merit ministers now?"

sentences.zh: 」哲曰：「皆在中州，惟桃豹孫鮮在焉。

translations.literal: Zhe said, "All are in the central provinces; only Tao Bao's grandson Xian is here."
translations.idiomatic: Zhe said: "All are in the central provinces; only Tao Bao's grandson Xian is here."

sentences.zh: 」素弗召為左常侍，論者歸其有宰衡之度。

translations.literal: Sufu summoned him as Left Regular Attendant; discussants attributed to him the measure of chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Sufu summoned him as left regular attendant; discussants attributed to him the measure of chief minister.

sentences.zh: 跋之七年死，跋哭之哀慟。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Ba's reign Sufu died; Ba wept for him with bitter grief.
translations.idiomatic: In Ba's seventh year Sufu died; Ba wept for him with bitter grief.

sentences.zh: 比葬，七臨之。

translations.literal: By the time of burial he visited the tomb seven times.
translations.idiomatic: By burial he visited the tomb seven times.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：自五胡縱慝，九域淪胥，帝裏神州，遂混之於荒裔，鴻名寶位，咸假之於雜種。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: From the time the Five Hu ran wild in cruelty, the nine domains sank into ruin; the imperial capital of the divine land was then mixed with the wild borderlands; great name and precious throne were all borrowed by mixed breeds.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: From the time the Five Hu ran wild, the nine domains sank; the imperial capital was mixed with the wild borderlands; throne and great name were borrowed by mixed breeds.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂戎狄凶囂，未窺道德，欺天擅命，抑乃其常。

translations.literal: One might say the Rong and Di are fierce and insolent, never glimpsing morality, deceiving Heaven and usurping mandate—suppressing this is their constant.
translations.idiomatic: One might say the Rong and Di are fierce, never glimpsing morality, deceiving Heaven and usurping mandate—that is their constant.

sentences.zh: 而馮跋出自中州，有殊丑類，因鮮卑之昏虐，亦盜名於海隅。

translations.literal: Yet Feng Ba came forth from the central provinces and was of a different ugly kind; riding on Xianbei benighted cruelty, he also stole a name on the seacoast.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Feng Ba came from the central provinces, a different kind; riding Xianbei cruelty, he stole a name on the seacoast.

sentences.zh: 然其遷徙之餘，少非雄傑，幸以寬厚為眾所推。

translations.literal: Yet among the remnant of migration he was in youth no hero; lucky to be pushed forward by the masses for his generosity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet among migrants he was in youth no hero; he was lucky to be pushed forward for his generosity.

sentences.zh: 初雖砥礪，終罕成德，舊史稱其信惑妖祀，斥黜諫臣，無開馭之才，異經決之士，信矣。

translations.literal: At first he did hone himself, yet in the end he rarely achieved virtue; old histories call him one who believed strange cults, drove away remonstrating ministers, lacked talent for driving the chariot, and differed from masters who decide by the classics—true indeed.
translations.idiomatic: At first he honed himself, yet rarely achieved virtue; old histories call him one who believed strange cults, drove away remonstrating ministers, and lacked talent for rule—true indeed.

sentences.zh: 速禍致寇，良謂在茲。

translations.literal: Hastening calamity and inviting the foe—truly it lies here.
translations.idiomatic: Hastening calamity and inviting the foe—truly it lies here.

sentences.zh: 猶能撫育黎萌，保守疆宇，發號施令，二十餘年，豈天意乎，非人事也！

translations.literal: Yet he could nurture the people and preserve the borders, issue orders and decrees for more than twenty years—is it Heaven's will, not human effort!
translations.idiomatic: Yet he could nurture the people and preserve the borders for more than twenty years—is it Heaven's will, not human effort!

translations.literal: 【Praise】
translations.idiomatic: 【Praise】

sentences.zh: 贊曰：國仁驍武，乾歸勇悍。

translations.literal: The praise says: Guoren was fierce in martial bearing, Gangui brave and fierce.
translations.idiomatic: The praise says: Guoren was fierce in martial bearing, Gangui brave and fierce.

sentences.zh: 矯矯熾磐，臨機能斷。

translations.literal: Chipan, spirited and soaring, faced opportunity and could decide.
translations.idiomatic: Chipan, spirited and soaring, faced opportunity and could decide.

sentences.zh: 孰謂獯虜，亦懷沈算。

translations.literal: Who would say the barbarian herdsmen also harbored deep stratagems.
translations.idiomatic: Who would say the barbarian herdsmen also harbored deep stratagems.

sentences.zh: 文起常才，憑時叛換。

translations.literal: Wenqi was an ordinary talent of the constant age who, relying on the times, rebelled and changed sides.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqi was an ordinary talent who, relying on the times, rebelled and changed sides.

sentences.zh: 咸竊大寶，為我多難。

translations.literal: All presumptuously stole the great treasure, bringing many calamities upon us.
translations.idiomatic: They all usurped the imperial throne and brought manifold calamities upon the land.
